name: ES7243
description: The `es7243` platform allows your ESPHome devices to use the ES7243 stereo audio ADC ([datasheet](http://www.everest-semi.com/pdf/ES7243%20PB.pdf)). This allows attached microphones to be used as a microphone input via [I2S Audio](https://esphome.io/components/microphone/i2s_audio/). The chip is found on the ESP32-LyraT-Mini.

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: The I²C address of the driver. Defaults to `0x13`.

config_entries.label: I2C ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the [I²C bus](https://esphome.io/components/i2c/) the ES7243 is connected to.

config_entries.label: I2S Audio ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the [I2S Audio](https://esphome.io/components/i2s_audio/) bus whose `i2s_mclk_pin` clocks the chip. Required when more than one bus is configured.

config_entries.label: Mic Gain
config_entries.description: The gain applied to the ADC microphones. One of `1dB`, `3.5dB`, `18dB`, `20.5dB`, `22.5dB`, `24.5dB`, `25dB` or `27dB`. Defaults to `27dB`.
